summary: Frontend-only iteration 12 verified. InteractiveDemoSection rebuild (7 views, sidebar, topbar) works end-to-end. Tab pills + sidebar nav both switch the active view. All 7 active sidebar items are clickable; 7 inactive items are present and disabled (as designed). Topbar shows 'Quantro OS / <title>' breadcrumb, Q2 LEVEL 10 badge and CO avatar. Scorecard renders all 6 expected rows. Quantro Revenue renders Decision Engine subtitle, all 4 KPIs, Revenue Decisions list and Quadrant analysis. Agents view renders all 6 expected agent cards. Navbar + Footer use the new QuantroLogoMark SVG with 'Quantro' wordmark. AmanecerSection shows '-$1,399' in amber-400 with AlertTriangle icon. PricingSection inclusion strip shows ES/EN copy correctly. Mobile menu wraps LanguageSwitcher in a flex justify-center container. ES↔EN toggle correctly switches the agents tab label between 'Agentes IA' and 'AI Agents'. No frontend errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: InteractiveDemoSection.jsx is 1593 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting per-view components (DashboardView, ScorecardView, RocksView, IssuesView, TodosView, AgentsView, RevenueView) and shared atoms (StatusDot, Pill, Avatar, Card, KpiCard, Sidebar, Topbar) into their own files under components/sections/demo/.
Unused import `Circle` (lucide-react) in InteractiveDemoSection.jsx — minor lint nit.

Sidebar disabled items use cursor-default with no aria-disabled attribute; consider adding aria-disabled="true" for a11y on the disabled SidebarItem buttons (already have HTML disabled, which is enough but explicit aria helps screen readers in some flows).
QuantroLogoMark filter id `q-glow` is hardcoded — if multiple instances render in the same SVG context (rare here), id collisions could happen. Consider useId() or unique suffix for safety.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was last fully validated in iteration_11 and untouched. Iteration 12 is pure frontend (demo rebuild, logo unification, favicon, mobile menu centering, Amanecer amber risk, Pricing inclusion copy). All requested checks passed. False-negative to be aware of when scripting: KpiCard labels use CSS `text-transform: uppercase` so Playwright inner_text returns them uppercased (e.g., 'REVENUE MTD' not 'Revenue MTD') — assert case-insensitively or against the source label. Demo data is fully MOCKED by design (UI-only); there are no real APIs behind the 7 demo views.
